raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Frozen-KV MTP (Gemma 4) isn't connected to the adaptive spec controller, so it runs the same number of steps at every batch size. At large batch this costs a lot: on H20 with Gemma-4-12B, fixed 2-step is 24% slower than plain decode at bs 24 and 30–36% slower at bs 32–128. Even at 0 steps, Frozen-KV still pays for a width-1 target verify.

## Changes

- Frozen-KV draft backends and graphs are built as adaptive runtime states, and the existing `AdaptiveController` switches between them. There is no new policy.
- Opt-in `SGLANG_FROZEN_KV_ZERO_DECODE=1`: at 0 steps, run the ordinary target DECODE CUDA graph instead of a width-1 verify. Three things needed care:
  - the bonus token carried over from the last spec round has to be consumed at the right KV position;
  - the hidden seed is copied out before the graph reuses its storage;
  - Frozen-KV has no draft-extend forward, so the scheduler's write-after-read fence now waits on the target runner's read-done event, including across consecutive 0-step rounds.
- Grammar, logprobs and HiSparse stay on width-1 verify, and a verify batch is never replayed through the DECODE graph.
- Scope: CUDA, PP=1, Triton attention, topk=1. The adaptive docs are updated.

## Results

H20, Gemma-4-12B BF16, TP1, Triton attention.

The example policy uses 2 steps below padded batch 16 and 0 steps from 16 up. I chose the boundary after looking at the decode and static 2-step runs, so treat it as an example rather than a tuned default.

Fixed batch, 256-token prompts, 128 output tokens, 2 servers × 3 samples each:

| batch | decode | static 2-step | adaptive | adaptive vs decode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 106.2 | 137.1 | 137.0 | +29.0% |
| 8 | 651.5 | 703.1 | 703.0 | +7.9% |
| 16 | 1040.9 | 894.9 | 1033.7 | −0.7% |
| 32 | 1422.4 | 1000.5 | 1407.6 | −1.0% |
| 128 | 1699.7 | 1088.6 | 1674.9 | −1.5% |

At large batch, adaptive recovers almost all of what static 2-step loses. The remaining ~1% gap is the cost of the zero-step path compared with plain decode.

Under changing load (concurrency 4 → 64 → 8, 30 s per phase, no drain between phases), average throughput over the 90 s is 1415.7 / 886.3 / 1484.6 tok/s for decode / static 2-step / adaptive. That is +67.5% over static 2-step and +4.9% over decode. The last phase (concurrency 8) shows no clear gain over decode.

Accuracy on GSM8K, 300 questions, temperature 0: decode 293, static 2-step 291, adaptive 291. Static 2-step and adaptive agree on every question. At switch points, 22k checks of hidden state, bonus token and sequence length matched between graph and eager.

Upstream reports the wrong acceptance *rate* under adaptive until #44902 lands, so I only report accept length here. Tests: 44 unit tests covering state construction and switching, zero-step frontier and seed handling, graph-mode guards and scheduler fencing.

<details><summary>Benchmark setup</summary>

- Run order: decode → static 2-step → zero → adaptive → adaptive → zero → static 2-step → decode, with batch order reversed in the second half. Profiler and debug checks are off.
- Throughput is HTTP wall time and includes prefill.
- One adaptive run under changing load was discarded because the disk filled partway through; it was rerun from scratch.

</details>

+"""Frozen-specific adaptive state and zero-step contracts."""

+                FrozenKVMTPDraftWorker._capture_cuda_graphs(worker)
+            self.assertIsNone(worker.cuda_graph_runner)
+
+    def test_fresh_backend_binding_and_workspace_restore(self):
+        backend = object()
+        runner = NS(init_new_workspace=False)
+
+        def build(**kwargs):
+            self.assertTrue(kwargs["init_new_workspace"])
+            runner.init_new_workspace = True

+
+        runner._get_attention_backend = build

+                self.assertEqual(dw.speculative_num_draft_tokens, step + 1)

+    def test_capture_failure_restores_all_runtime_bindings(self):
+        worker = self.make_worker()
+        worker.speculative_num_steps = 2
+        worker.speculative_num_draft_tokens = 3

+        dw.speculative_num_steps = 2
+        dw.speculative_num_draft_tokens = 3
+        dw.draft_attn_backend = object()
+        dw.draft_extend_attn_backend = None
+        dw.draft_runner.draft_attn_backend = dw.draft_attn_backend
+        dw.draft_runner.attn_backend = dw.draft_attn_backend
+        dw.cuda_graph_runner = object()
+        dw.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend = None
+        original = dict(vars(dw))
+        original_runner = dict(vars(dw.draft_runner))

+        def override(reason, **kwargs):

+        with (

+                self.assertTrue(graph.disable_cuda_graph)
+                dw.draft_attn_backend = object()
+                dw.draft_runner.attn_backend = object()
+                dw.draft_runner.draft_attn_backend = object()
+                dw.cuda_graph_runner = None
+                raise RuntimeError("capture failed")
+        self.assertEqual(vars(dw), original)
+        self.assertEqual(vars(dw.draft_runner), original_runner)
+        self.assertEqual(worker.speculative_num_steps, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(worker.speculative_num_draft_tokens, 3)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            vars(spec), dict(speculative_num_steps=2, speculative_num_draft_tokens=3)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            vars(graph), dict(cuda_graph_bs_decode=[1, 8], disable_cuda_graph=False)
+        )
+
+    def test_zero_step_uses_frozen_tag_and_one_node(self):
+        worker = self.make_worker()
+        worker.device = "cpu"

+        self.assertEqual(result.draft_token_num, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result.max_tree_depth, 1)

+        self.assertTrue(result.custom_mask.all())

+        idle = worker._build_trivial_verify_input(batch)
+        self.assertIsInstance(idle, FrozenKVMTPVerifyInput)
+        self.assertEqual(idle.spec_input_type, SpecInputType.FROZEN_KV_MTP_VERIFY)
+
+    def test_frozen_configuration_gate(self):
+        cfg = NS(
+            speculative_algorithm="FROZEN_KV_MTP",
+            device="cuda",
+            pp_size=1,
+            attention_backend="triton",
+            prefill_attention_backend=None,
+            decode_attention_backend=None,
+            speculative_draft_attention_backend=None,

+                self.assertIsNotNone(adaptive_unsupported_reason(cfg))

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+import unittest

+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.utils import GenerationBatchResult

+    DecodeCudaGraphRunner,
+)

+    FrozenKVMTPDraftWorker,
+    FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=5, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+MODULE = "sglang.srt.speculative.frozen_kv_mtp_worker_v2"
+
+
+class TestFrozenZeroDecode(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_war_fence_uses_target_for_both_zero_and_positive_steps(self):
+        target = object()
+        for steps in (0, 2):
+            worker = NS(
+                speculative_num_steps=steps,
+                _target_worker=NS(model_runner=target),
+                _draft_worker=NS(draft_runner=object()),
+            )
+            self.assertIs(
+                FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2.last_shared_read_runner.fget(worker), target
+            )
+
+    def test_capture_mode_and_fallback_gates(self):
+        worker = NS(speculative_num_steps=0)
+        batch = NS(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+            has_grammar=False,
+            return_logprob=False,
+            hisparse_coordinator=None,
+        )
+        with patch(
+            f"{MODULE}.envs.SGLANG_FROZEN_KV_ZERO_DECODE.get", return_value=True
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(
+                FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._target_graph_capture_kwargs(worker, 0),
+                dict(
+                    capture_forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+                    capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.FULL,
+                ),
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._target_graph_capture_kwargs(worker, 2), {}
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._use_zero_decode(worker, batch))
+            for key, value in (
+                ("has_grammar", True),
+                ("return_logprob", True),
+                ("hisparse_coordinator", object()),
+                ("forward_mode", ForwardMode.IDLE),
+            ):
+                old = getattr(batch, key)
+                setattr(batch, key, value)
+                self.assertFalse(FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._use_zero_decode(worker, batch))
+                setattr(batch, key, old)
+        with patch(
+            f"{MODULE}.envs.SGLANG_FROZEN_KV_ZERO_DECODE.get", return_value=False
+        ):
+            self.assertFalse(FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._use_zero_decode(worker, batch))
+            self.assertEqual(
+                FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._target_graph_capture_kwargs(worker, 0), {}
+            )
+
+    def test_decode_graph_cannot_replay_verify_even_at_width_one(self):
+        runner = NS(
+            capture_forward_mode_override=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+            capture_forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            DecodeCudaGraphRunner.can_run_graph(
+                runner, NS(forward_mode=ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY)
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertIsNone(DecodeCudaGraphRunner.get_spec_info(runner, 8))
+
+    def test_zero_round_preserves_frontier_and_owns_seed_hidden(self):
+        for cpu_lengths in (True, False):
+            with self.subTest(cpu_lengths=cpu_lengths):
+                self.check_two_rounds(cpu_lengths)
+
+    def check_two_rounds(self, cpu_lengths):
+        hidden_buffer = torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(3, 4)
+        seed_builder = NS(topk=1)
+        seed_builder._build_seed_draft_input = lambda tokens, hidden: (
+            FrozenKVMTPDraftWorker._build_seed_draft_input(seed_builder, tokens, hidden)
+        )
+        target = NS(model_runner=NS())
+        seen = []
+
+        def forward(*, batch, forward_batch):
+            self.assertIsNone(batch)
+            self.assertIsNone(forward_batch.spec_info)
+            self.assertEqual(forward_batch.forward_mode, ForwardMode.DECODE)
+            seen.append(forward_batch)
+            return GenerationBatchResult(
+                next_token_ids=forward_batch.input_ids + 10,
+                logits_output=NS(hidden_states=hidden_buffer),
+                can_run_cuda_graph=True,
+            )
+
+        target.forward_batch_generation = forward
+        worker = NS(
+            device="cpu",
+            req_to_token_pool=NS(req_to_token=object()),
+            _target_worker=target,
+            draft_worker=seed_builder,
+        )
+        old_seed = NS(bonus_tokens=torch.tensor([5, 6, 7]))
+        batch = NS(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor([1023, 1024, 2047], dtype=torch.int32),
+            seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([1023, 1024, 2047]) if cpu_lengths else None,
+            req_pool_indices=torch.tensor([4, 2, 9]),
+            spec_info=old_seed,
+        )
+        original_lengths = batch.seq_lens.clone()
+        publish = Mock()
+        locations = Mock(return_value=torch.tensor([31, 32, 63]))
+        with (
+            patch(f"{MODULE}.assign_extend_cache_locs_uniform_func", locations),
+            patch(
+                f"{MODULE}.torch.get_device_module",
+                return_value=NS(current_stream=lambda: None),
+            ),
+            patch(f"{MODULE}.record_stream_each"),
+            patch(f"{MODULE}.ForwardBatch.init_new", side_effect=lambda b, *a, **kw: b),
+        ):
+            result = FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2._forward_zero_decode(worker, batch, publish)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(batch.seq_lens, original_lengths)
+            self.assertIs(batch.spec_info, old_seed)
+            self.assertIs(locations.call_args.kwargs["start_offset"], batch.seq_lens)
+            self.assertEqual(locations.call_args.kwargs["draft_token_num"], 1)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(result.new_seq_lens, original_lengths + 1)
+            self.assertIs(publish.call_args.args[0], result.new_seq_lens)
+            self.assertIs(result.extra_keep_alive_refs[0], seen[0])
+            self.assertEqual(result.speculative_num_draft_tokens, 1)
+            self.assertEqual(result.accept_lens.tolist(), [1, 1, 1])
